description: AWS Backup vault does not have Vault Lock enabled
rationale: The observed Backup vault explicitly reports Locked=false. Vault Lock can help protect recovery points against premature deletion; this rule does not prove backups are missing, ineffective, or required to be immutable under a particular benchmark.
remediation: Review the vault ARN and retention requirements. Evaluate AWS Backup Vault Lock (governance/compliance mode), retention ranges, cross-account recovery and restore testing; confirm the chosen operational mode before enabling.
